description: This header file defines the NetworkManagerClient class, which provides an interface for managing network interfaces, WiFi connections, and related operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes function declarations for retrieving and setting network interface details, WiFi SSIDs, and device information, as well as methods for WiFi scanning, connection management, and WPS operations.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing network management functionalities such as interface configuration, WiFi management, and WPS operations within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary network interface.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for the specified interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks whether the specified interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP configuration for a specific interface.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Gets the list of known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Get information about the currently connected SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the list of known networks.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the list of known networks.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi scan was performed recently within a defined time limit.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specified network interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network with given credentials.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a previously known WiFi connection.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Obtains signal quality metrics for a WiFi network.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Begins the WPS push-button setup process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops any ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection configurations.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Internal method to handle WPS process management.

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Checks if a given SSID matches available networks.

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Determines if the active access point matches the WPS SSID.
